    Features

    Microcontroller based Automatic Changeover

    Microcontroller based circuit for the faster and better response.

    Inbuilt SMPS for low power consumption

    PCB based circuit consumes very low amount of power.

    Operational status indication through LEDs

    LEDs indication provides the operating status of ACCL.

    Manual reset provision

    Manual reset provision provided to reset when ACCL goes to sleep mode.

    Staggered terminal design

    Staggered terminal design for better isolation between phase and neutral.
